title: Nordics reservations & SKU bundles GTM orchestration
creator: Asha Raman
description: Goal: Coordinate cross-functional launch of Dedicated capacity in the Nordics region with new SKU bundles and reservation pricing. This ticket owns GTM orchestration: release notes, console listing, pricing page updates, billing validation, partner comms, and enablement for Sales/SEs and Solutions. The launch introduces: 1) new instance family 'rwi-g5-small' (optimized for <30ms p50 token latency on typical chat workloads); 2) two reservation bundles (Standard Monthly and Annual Commitments) with burst credits and predictable egress pricing; 3) console UX for region selection and reservation purchase flow; and 4) updated monitoring dashboards (per-region latency & utilization).
acceptance_criteria: Release notes drafted, reviewed by Eng/Security/Legal and published to docs.redwood.com
Pricing page updated with Nordics SKUs, commit tiers, and examples showing cost per 1M tokens
Billing tests passing for monthly & annual reservation charges in staging and a signed-off reconciliation run
Console region + reservation purchase flow QA'd across Chrome/Firefox and documented in support playbook
Seq-based rollout plan created that allows canary users and automated fallback to global pools
Sales + SE enablement deck and one-pager complete and shared with Field by due_date
checklist: Finalize SKU names and internal codes (billing/system mapping)
Coordinate Eng rollout window & migration plan for capacity pools
Prepare release_notes draft and get Legal sign-off
Update Console UI strings and create screenshots for release notes
Run billing reconciliation smoke tests with finance
Create partner announcement draft for reseller partners in Nordics
Publish KB articles for customers covering reservation lifecycle and refunds
Schedule post-launch 72-hour incident war room on-call rotation
timeline: 2026-02-16: Kickoff + confirm SKU/price ranges with Finance and Eng
2026-02-25: Eng provides capacity RFQ & target latency profiles

risks: Pricing mismatch between console and billing backend - could lead to incorrect customer charges
Capacity overcommit during initial GA spike causing degraded latencies
Release notes missing region-specific compliance wording - legal/regulatory exposure
Partner/reseller catalog sync delays leading to go-to-market timing differences
Localization gaps for Nordic languages in console leading to support load
mitigations: Hold a pre-launch billing dry-run and reconciliation; require green from Finance
Enable automated capacity fallback to global pools with throttling to protect latency SLOs
Run a legal checklist specifically for region-specific terminology and data residency claims
Coordinate with Partner Ops to stage catalog updates one week before GA
Ship English-first with localized FAQ patches in week+1 and designate support triage ownership
release_notes_draft: New: Dedicated capacity in Nordics region (nordic-1) — Includes new rwi-g5-small instance type optimized for low-latency chat workloads. Reservation bundles: Standard Monthly (pay-monthly with discounted unit rates) and Annual Commitments (deep discounts + burst credits). Console: region selector + reservation purchase flow. Observability: per-region latency & utilization charts in Console. Known limitations: initial GA does not include all quantization profiles; customers with strict on-prem requirements should contact our solutions team.
